title: Vijayanagara art and architecture
quote: Vijayanagara architecture = "matured state of the Dravidian tradition" (Percy Brown)

boxes.title: Style: key features
head: Feature
Meaning
rows: Towering gateway that dwarfs the central shrine

boxes.title: Roots & spread
items: Blends **Chola, Hoysala, Pandya, Chalukya**; models: **Chalukya and Chola**
==New: **secular buildings inside temple premises**==
Pillared corridors added to older temples
Spread via courts at **Kondavidu, Udayagiri, Chandragiri, Vinukonda**
Hampi = **UNESCO** site (**1986**); Vittala stone chariot on **₹50 note**

boxes.title: Lepakshi
items: **Veerabhadra (Papanaseswara)** temple on **Kurma Shailam**; Sri Sathya Sai dist., near **Hindupur**
Built c. **1530s** (Achyutaraya) by **Virupanna & Veeranna** (⚠ other notes: Krishnadevaraya)
==**Hanging pillar**==; **monolithic Nandi** (APPSC 2017)
**Naga linga**: seven-hooded serpent, single boulder
Murals = peak of **Vijayanagara school**; "**pictorial inscriptions**" (APPSC 2019)
Walls: **Parvati Parinayamu**, Tripurasura Samharam; ceilings: epics

boxes.title: Painting & performing arts
items: Hampi Virupaksha murals: **Dashavatara**, **Girijakalyana**
**Mineral pigments** on lime plaster; bold outlines, flat colours
Source: **Stella Kramrisch**, A Survey of Painting in the Deccan
**Yakshaganam**: royal court; ==**Tolu Bommalata**: rural people== (APPSC 2019)
**Veedhi Bhagavatham** → forerunner of **Kuchipudi**
**Sangita Suryodaya**: Krishnadevaraya's court musician

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Hazara Rama = ==**Krishnadevaraya**== (APPSC 2025 key) - ⚠ other notes: Devaraya I / II
Stone bull, hanging pillar, frescoes → **Lepakshi**
"Gopurams better than Hampi" → ==**Tadipatri**==
Mukha mandapam = Harihara II; prakaram = Shanti Lingayya
Lotus Mahal = Indo-Islamic; Huzur Daftar = Indo-Persian
